# Bobs Drawn Shovels

---

## Unique Art Style
Ever wanted your Shovel to look like they were drawn by someone who has never seen a Shovel before? Now they can!

Tired of those realistic texture packs? Then welcome to **Bobs Drawn Shovels**, the only pack where the bad looks are the best part! This pack replaces every single shovel texture, drawn by **me**.
